title: Constructed source comparison in degree zero
statement: For f:X→S, g:S′→S and W⊆g⁻¹V, construct the natural isomorphism from restriction of Lg*Rf*(G[0]) to L(g|W)*R(f|V)*((G|f⁻¹V)[0]) using the pinned composition comparisons, the constructed exact open-pullback comparisons, the sectionwise direct-image comparison and Mathlib single-complex restriction. Its component is the bare source comparison followed by L(g|W)*R(f|V)* of the single restriction map. proof.text: Construct the bottom pullback restriction isomorphism by open pullback, composition, the resLE square equality, inverse composition and open pullback again. Whisker the explicit direct-image restriction comparison and then Mathlib mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor. The component formula follows by expanding these compositions and eliminating the identity.

def openPinnedSingleDegreeZeroSourceIso
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (V : S.Opens) (W : S'.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V) :
    singleDegreeBaseChangeSource.{u, w} f g 0 ⋙
        (schemeOpenRestriction S' W).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) ⋙
        singleDegreeBaseChangeSource.{u, w} (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV) 0
